notes: Corrected: the supplied he at t002 now rides with διηγήσατο, whose subject it is, rather than with κατασείσας. The ASV renders this participle by an English participle (beckoning), which licenses no subject word, and every other participle in this chapter that takes a supplied subject is one the ASV rendered finite (12.9, 12.10, 12.12, 12.16, 12.19, 12.25). Rule 27 keeps the helper with what licenses it and rule 15 permits the discontinuity.
σιγᾶν takes to hold their peace whole, headed on peace under rule 17's support-frame clause.
Both forth and out of are written, so rule 106's addition arm gives each token its own word.
τε takes the And at t027 under rule 70, the verse's other καί tokens standing in no correlation with it.
